title: Chapter 443
text:
After a while, Han Xiao finally calmed himself down, gritted his teeth, and smiled.

Hehe, what's the big deal? Even if I didn't get it this time, I'll just get it again next time.

It was impossible for him to have a mental breakdown; he was already used to it. It was just like playing card games. Normal people had to rack their brains, but lucky people only had to play the cards they drew every round to win.

There was no need to panic at all.

After drinking a cup of water to calm himself down, he looked at the interface again. There were still three items waiting to be chosen.

None of the three items were precious, so Han Xiao could only choose the best one out of the bunch.

A small bottle of Potential Potion. Although Potential Points were important, it only gave him one point, which was too little. Han Xiao would only consider it if it was a medium or large bottle. A random Mechanic class blueprint. It looked good, but it was actually extremely trash. There were so many Mechanic class blueprints, and the chances of drawing trash were extremely high. Furthermore, even if he drew an extremely precious blueprint, it would most likely be a piece of equipment that could only be made by very high-level players. Without sufficient knowledge, he could only look at it but not touch it. It was completely useless. Furthermore, Han Xiao did not need a random blueprint at all. He remembered how to combine most of the blueprints, and he could do it himself.

After thinking about it, he felt that only having a blank Character Summon Card was not bad. If he chose to generate Ames' Character Summon Card, who knew what kind of effect it would have.

Although he had the Super Gene Extractor, it was obviously impossible for him to use it on Ames. He had never seen such a suicidal person before, and he did not want to detect Floating Dragon's attack on the way.

The lower limit was not low, but the upper limit was off the charts, so it was worth it.

You have received x1

Han Xiao nodded. I'll use this the next time I see the Dragon Emperor. Floating Dragon has no missions for me recently, and Ames' whereabouts are unknown. She won't come to me for no reason. If I can generate some overpowered effect, I might be able to use it as a trump card to challenge Grade A directly. It's not a bad choice.

No matter how strong the Character Summon Card was, it was still one's own ability, which fulfilled the requirements of the Promotion Mission. Although he did not get a Mission Completion Card this time, it provided him with a new method. Han Xiao used it as a backup option. Of course, the prerequisite was that he had to draw an extremely strong ability from Ames. It would be best if it was the kind that could crush a Grade A Super in one hit.

At present, Han Xiao was inclined to continue trying the Random Reward. Although the results were not satisfactory for the time being, he felt that there was nothing wrong with his train of thought. He would not give up halfway because of a temporary setback.

After setting the destination, the spaceship started moving automatically. This rented spaceship was mainly for speed, so it was suitable for escaping.

This time, he had chosen a simple and brutal Boss farming quest. The process was very simple, and the rewards were not much. Han Xiao was currently in need of this kind of time-saving quest.

Furthermore, with Aroshia's promotion to B class, the strength of the party would increase significantly. Fighting a boss of similar level would definitely be much easier.

At the same time …

In a Star Field extremely far away from the Shattered Star Ring, a pitch black spaceship was quietly floating in the universe. The outer shell of this spaceship was extremely smooth and dense, like a black mirror that reflected the scenery of the galaxy. The exterior of the spaceship was fan-shaped from top to bottom, and from the front, it was in the shape of a rhombus.

The Prowler Class reconnaissance spaceship was commonly known as the 'Blacklight Stealth'. It was a technological creation of the Radiant Federation, and its stealth, detection, speed, and other equipment were all top-notch. Its technology far exceeded that of most civilizations, and it was extremely expensive to build. In the spaceship black market of the various Star Fields, the spaceships of the three Universal Civilizations were the most popular. A second-hand Blacklight Stealth could be sold for tens of millions of Enas, and it was a hero in the world of reconnaissance spaceships.

In other words, this thing was equivalent to a super high-end luxury sports car.

One millionth of a millisecond ago, a special wave frequency traveled through quantum entanglement and instantly crossed the distance of countless light years to reach this place. In the spaceship's cockpit, a finger-sized oval transparent glass cover was hanging on the top of the cockpit. When the cover received this special wave frequency, it immediately reacted and lit up with a golden light.

"Hmm?"

A voice sounded from the empty cockpit.

Countless streams of light appeared out of thin air and condensed into a glowing human figure. It reached out and touched the cover that was glowing faintly.

"Your energy signature has finally recovered to the level where the sensor can locate you. It turns out that you were thrown into the Shattered Star Ring by the wormhole. I'll find you very soon. Wait for me."

In the blink of an eye, this Blacklight Stealth turned into a stream of light and disappeared. It only needed a few microseconds of warming up before it could warp instantly. It was extremely agile and almost impossible to capture.

After Fu Ding left with the Black Star Mercenary, it caused quite a stir in the entertainment industry.

The news of 'Morning Star' giving up his singing career at the height of his career caused an uproar. Although the reporters and media did not know the inside story from Feidin, they were still imagining things. The news of 'revealing the inside story' spread quickly, shocking Morning Star's fans and causing a heated discussion.

However, these entertainment news and the mercenary industry were two completely different worlds, so Han Xiao did not care. Instead, his fame increased a little because of this, which made him take a second look at it.

After completing Chen Xing's mission, he did not waste any time and went to the next mission trigger location.

In a remote Star System in the Colton Star Cluster, the Godora Civilization had set up many research space stations to explore some uninhabited planets, investigate different plants, life forms, and planetary environments. There were many investigators like Kerlodd stationed in the space stations.

Godora Research Space Station No.075.

After receiving permission, the spaceship entered the space station and stopped at the dock.

After getting off the spaceship, everyone looked around. This space station was designed in a typical Godora style.

A few Godora investigators were waiting at the dock, and one of the leaders asked, "Black Star Mercenary, may I know why you're here?"

"We were passing by, and our spaceship needed fuel, so we came here to rest. We'll pay the corresponding fees, or we can do some hiring missions," Han Xiao said. "Is there anything you need to settle here?"

The leader hesitated for a moment and shook his head. "There's no extra work here. Since your spaceship needs to rest, you can use our shipyard."

Mercenaries were from the semi-neutral camp and were slightly inclined towards the lawful side. They had a pass by default and were able to dock at many strongholds of galactic civilizations. Before the spaceship entered the space station, Han Xiao and the others were notified. Because the Black Star Mercenary had a good reputation and had dealt with Dark-star a long time ago, the space station allowed Han Xiao and the others to dock.

If their negative reputation was too high or they were wanted, not only would they not be able to enter many places, but they would also be surrounded by the guards if their whereabouts were exposed.

After exchanging a few words, the Godora investigators led the way. Everyone left the dock and entered the resting area of the space station. According to the management manual, they had to leave after the spaceship's fuel was replenished.

Han Xiao naturally did not come here just to replenish fuel. This research space station could trigger a mission that he wanted. It was easy to get a high rating, and the process was quite simple.

The situation was as such. A research ship had lost contact with a desolate planet nearby, and the space station had sent a second team to search for it. However, they had also lost contact with it. As such, the space station had reported to the Godoran Investigation Department and waited for the headquarters to send more investigators to investigate the situation. As this was an internal matter, the Godoran investigator did not reveal the situation and did not need to seek help from the mercenaries.

However, players could trigger this mission through a character in the space station. This was not a hidden mission. As long as players paid attention to the clues, they could find the person who triggered it. This person was Han Xiao's target.
